Form 4 Chapter 4

Green Technology for Environmental Sustainability
17 question groups
Set 13 · Paper 1 · Q9
Original source

正确答案

B — Reduces pollution and protects the environment.

为什么是这个答案？

The ban reduces single-use plastic waste. Less plastic waste means less persistent pollution in drains, rivers and the sea, so the action supports environmental sustainability.

解题步骤

1) Spot the environmental action: banning conventional plastic straws. 2) Ask what direct environmental effect it has. 3) Eliminate options about drink chemicals, production cost and wastage because they are not the main Green Technology objective.

口诀

Plastic ↓ → Pollution ↓ → Environment protected.

关键词 Keywords

single-use plastic, pollution, environmental sustainability, Green Technology

Original source

正确答案

B — Paper / newspaper.

为什么是这个答案？

解题步骤

Identify bin colour → recall material category → match the picture.

口诀

BLUE = BOOKS / PAPER.

关键词 Keywords

recycling, blue bin, paper, waste separation

Set 13 · Paper 1 · Q11
Original source

正确答案

A — Rainwater harvesting system.

为什么是这个答案？

Rainwater harvesting is a Green Technology application because it conserves water and reduces dependence on treated water. Deforestation and excessive use of fertilisers/pesticides worsen socio-scientific issues.

解题步骤

Look for the option that reduces resource use and environmental impact, not one that creates pollution or habitat loss.

口诀

Green Tech = SAVE resources, not DAMAGE resources.

关键词 Keywords

rainwater harvesting, agriculture, forestry, resource conservation

Set 13 · Paper 2 · Q7
Original source

正确答案

(a) Carbon dioxide. (b) Any two: reduces carbon dioxide/air pollution, reduces fossil-fuel use, saves fuel, reduces traffic, helps prevent global warming. (c) Carry out the campaign continuously and strengthen awareness/incentives. (d) Examples: use public transport, plant trees, use renewable energy, recycle.

为什么是这个答案？

Vehicles that burn fossil fuels release carbon dioxide. Cycling and vehicle sharing reduce the number of fuel-burning vehicles, so less CO₂ is emitted and the carbon footprint falls.

解题步骤

For environmental structured questions use: Activity → pollutant/resource → environmental effect → improvement.

口诀

Less cars → less fuel → less CO₂ → smaller carbon footprint.

关键词 Keywords

carbon dioxide, fossil fuels, car pooling, cycling, carbon footprint, global warming

Original source

为什么是这个答案？

解题步骤

口诀

关键词 Keywords

carbon footprint, recycling, greenhouse gases, product life cycle

Set 14 · Paper 1 · Q30–Q32
Original source

正确答案

Q30 C — Eutrophication. Q31 D — Amount of dissolved oxygen needed by bacteria to break down organic substances. Q32 A — Recycle.

为什么是这个答案？

Q30: Excess nutrients cause rapid algal growth; decomposition then lowers dissolved oxygen, which is eutrophication. Q31: BOD is oxygen required by microorganisms to decompose organic matter. Q32: Recycling reduces plastic disposal and the need for new plastic production.

解题步骤

Eutrophication chain: nutrients ↑ → algae ↑ → decomposition ↑ → dissolved O₂ ↓. BOD: more organic waste → bacteria use more oxygen → BOD ↑.

口诀

BOD: Bacteria Oxygen Demand. High BOD = dirty water.

关键词 Keywords

eutrophication, BOD, dissolved oxygen, organic waste, recycling

carbon handprint, carbon footprint, life cycle, environmental impact

Form 5 Chapter 4

Rate of Reaction
8 question groups
Set 15 · Paper 2 · Q4
Original source

正确答案

(a) Plot gas volume (cm³) on the y-axis against time (min) on the x-axis using the given points. (b) Average rate for first 3 min = 80 cm³ ÷ 3 min = 26.67 cm³ min⁻¹. (c) With marble chips, the average rate is lower than 26.67 cm³ min⁻¹.

为什么是这个答案？

Powder has a larger total surface area than chips. More exposed particles means more frequent effective collisions, so the reaction is faster.

解题步骤

Rate = change in measurable quantity ÷ time. Here: gas volume ÷ time. For graph: label axes + units → choose scale → plot points → smooth curve.

口诀

RATE = CHANGE ÷ TIME. Smaller pieces → bigger surface → faster.

关键词 Keywords

average rate, gas volume, time, surface area, effective collision, marble powder

Set 16 · Paper 1 · Q21–Q22
Original source

正确答案

Q21 A — Contact Process. Q22 B — 0.4 g min⁻¹.

为什么是这个答案？

Q21: Sulphur dioxide + oxygen → sulphur trioxide is the key stage of the Contact Process. Q22: Rate = 0.8 g ÷ 2.0 min = 0.4 g min⁻¹.

解题步骤

Recognise industrial equation; then use rate = amount reacted ÷ time.

口诀

Contact: SO₂ → SO₃. Rate = amount/time.

关键词 Keywords

Contact Process, sulphur trioxide, rate of reaction, g min⁻¹

Set 17 · Paper 1 · Q23–Q24
Original source

正确答案

Q23 C — Increase in volume of carbon dioxide gas. Q24 B — the slow-reaction example shown in option B.

为什么是这个答案？

CaCO₃ + HCl produces CO₂, so gas volume is an easy measurable change with time. Slow reactions take a long time to produce an observable change, unlike burning/explosive reactions.

解题步骤

Choose a quantity that changes continuously and can be measured with time.

口诀

Gas reaction? Measure GAS VOLUME.

关键词 Keywords

measurable change, carbon dioxide, slow reaction, reaction rate

Set 17 · Paper 1 · Q25–Q26
Original source

正确答案

Q25 D — Iron filings. Q26 B — Slice the meat thinly.

为什么是这个答案？

Iron is the catalyst used in the Haber Process. Thin slices have a larger total exposed surface area, increasing the rate of processes involved in cooking.

解题步骤

Catalyst question: recall Haber = iron. Size question: smaller size → larger surface area → faster.

口诀

Haber has IRON. Thin = fast.

关键词 Keywords

Haber Process, iron catalyst, surface area, size of reactant

Set 17 · Paper 2 · Q13
Original source

正确答案

(a)(i) Similarity: reactant quantity decreases / product quantity increases. Difference: fast reaction has high rate and short completion time; slow reaction has low rate and long completion time. (ii) Cheese making is a slow process and takes a long time, especially for high-quality cheese, increasing production cost. (b) Haber factors: pressure 200 atm; iron catalyst; temperature 450–550°C. (c) Limestone K; it is smaller, giving larger total surface area and therefore a faster rate.

为什么是这个答案？

Higher pressure increases collisions between gaseous particles, higher temperature raises kinetic energy, and a catalyst provides an easier reaction pathway. Smaller limestone increases exposed surface area.

解题步骤

For factor questions always write Factor → particle/collision effect → rate increases.

口诀

Haber: 200 atm + 450–550°C + Fe. Small solid = fast.

关键词 Keywords

fast reaction, slow reaction, Haber Process, pressure, catalyst, temperature, surface area

Set 18 · Paper 1 · Q24
Original source

正确答案

B — 0.4 cm³ s⁻¹.

为什么是这个答案？

The reaction reaches its final gas volume of 36 cm³ at 90 s. Average rate = total gas produced ÷ time taken = 36 ÷ 90 = 0.4 cm³ s⁻¹.

解题步骤

Use the time when the reaction is complete, not a later time after the graph/table has become constant.

口诀

Average rate = FINAL change ÷ completion time.

关键词 Keywords

average rate, gas volume, completion time, cm³ s⁻¹

Set 18 · Paper 1 · Q26–Q27
Original source

正确答案

Q26 A — Temperature of reactants. Q27 B — To increase the rate of reaction.

为什么是这个答案？

Temperature is a standard factor affecting reaction rate. Vanadium(V) oxide is a catalyst in the Contact Process, so its role is to increase rate without being consumed.

解题步骤

Reaction-rate factors: temperature, concentration, size/surface area, catalyst (and pressure for gases).

口诀

TCSC: Temperature, Concentration, Size, Catalyst.

关键词 Keywords

temperature, catalyst, vanadium(V) oxide, Contact Process

Set 18 · Paper 2 · Q12
Original source

正确答案

(a) Fast: combustion. Slow: rusting. (b) Any three: higher temperature → higher rate; higher concentration → higher rate; smaller solid reactant size → higher rate; presence of catalyst → higher rate. (c) Haber: nitrogen + hydrogen → ammonia; ammonia is used to make fertiliser; conditions include 450–550°C, 200 atm and iron filings catalyst.

为什么是这个答案？

Increasing temperature/concentration/surface area raises the frequency or effectiveness of collisions. A catalyst lowers the activation-energy barrier. Haber conditions are chosen to obtain an industrially useful reaction rate.

解题步骤

For 6-mark factor question: 1 mark factor + 1 mark correct effect, repeated three times.

口诀

TCSC + Haber = N₂ + H₂ → NH₃; 200 atm, 450–550°C, Fe.

关键词 Keywords

combustion, rusting, temperature, concentration, surface area, catalyst, Haber Process

Original source

Set 16 · Paper 2 · Q1
Original source

正确答案

Key marking points: voltage for zinc–lead = 0.6 V; the reading shows electrical current/energy is produced; factor changed = pair/type of metals; a chemical cell/battery is an application; using the same metal pair gives 0 V/no reading.

为什么是这个答案？

Different metals have different tendencies to release electrons, creating a potential difference. The greater the difference between the metals, the larger the voltage. Two identical metals have no potential difference.

解题步骤

Observation → infer electrical energy → identify manipulated variable (metal pair) → apply concept → predict same-metal result.

口诀

Different metals = voltage; same metals = 0 V.

关键词 Keywords

chemical cell, voltage, pair of metals, electrical energy, potential difference

Set 17 · Paper 2 · Q9
Original source

正确答案

(c) Electroplate the iron gate with a more suitable metal such as copper/silver (protective coating). (d) Design: insert iron nail and coin into a lemon, connect them by crocodile clips to the bulb; the two different metals act as electrodes and lemon juice as electrolyte.

Form 5 Chapter 8

Force and Pressure
4 question groups
Set 16 · Paper 1 · Q34–Q35
Original source

正确答案

Q34 A — the region with the fastest airflow/lowest pressure shown in the diagram. Q35 C — Higher pressure behind the paper pushes it towards the fast-flowing water.

为什么是这个答案？

Bernoulli’s principle states that where fluid speed is higher, pressure is lower. The pressure difference pushes the paper toward the low-pressure region.

解题步骤

Find fastest flow → that region has lowest pressure → compare pressure on both sides → force acts from high to low pressure.

口诀

FAST fluid = LOW pressure.

关键词 Keywords

Bernoulli's principle, fluid speed, pressure difference, airflow

Hydraulic equipment works using Pascal’s principle: pressure applied to an enclosed liquid is transmitted equally in all directions.

Set 17 · Paper 1 · Q36
Original source

正确答案

D — The pressure at cylinder X is the same as the pressure at cylinder Y.

为什么是这个答案？

According to Pascal’s principle, pressure applied to an enclosed liquid is transmitted equally throughout the liquid. Different piston areas produce different forces, but the transmitted pressure is the same.

解题步骤

Pressure same; force changes with area: F = PA.

口诀

Pascal: SAME P, different F.

关键词 Keywords

Pascal's principle, pressure, hydraulic system, piston area

Set 17 · Paper 2 · Q3
Original source

正确答案

(a)(i) Water level at Q is the lowest. (a)(ii) Pressure at Q is the lowest because water velocity is fastest there. (b) Responding factor: water level in tubes P, Q and R. (c) Operational definition: Bernoulli’s principle is shown when water flowing through the narrowest part of a Venturi tube has the highest velocity and produces the lowest pressure/water-column level. (Application accepted in the scheme includes a Bunsen burner.)

为什么是这个答案？

At the narrow section, fluid moves faster. Bernoulli’s principle links higher fluid speed with lower pressure, so the vertical water level is lowest there.

解题步骤

Observation (what you see) → inference (why) → responding variable (what changes) → operational definition (concept + what is measured/observed).

口诀

NARROW → FAST → LOW pressure → LOW water level.

关键词 Keywords

Bernoulli's principle, Venturi tube, water level, velocity, pressure, operational definition
